selected_memories.text: When LOR-88 is activated, it changes TAM-10 into an active carrier.
An active TAM-10 causes VIX-21 to be emitted.
Whenever VIX-21 reaches QEN-32, that QEN-32 adopts the terminal marker BUP-43.
Rumor claims QEN-32 instead carries terminal marker BAD-60.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of VIX-21 through QEN-32 is BUP-43; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Whenever VIX-38 reaches QEN-49, that QEN-49 adopts the terminal marker BUP-60.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of VIX-38 through QEN-49 is BUP-60; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims QEN-49 instead carries terminal marker BAD-77.
An active TAM-27 causes VIX-38 to be emitted.
When LOR-16 is activated, it changes TAM-27 into an active carrier.
An active TAM-44 causes VIX-55 to be emitted.
When LOR-33 is activated, it changes TAM-44 into an active carrier.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of VIX-55 through QEN-66 is BUP-77; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims QEN-66 instead carries terminal marker BAD-94.
Whenever VIX-55 reaches QEN-66, that QEN-66 adopts the terminal marker BUP-77.
